{{Quote|Folks call me "Zella." Former swoop rider, retired now. Couldn't stay away long, though.|Zella|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Zella''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[third Galactic War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zella first appeared in the [[June]] [[2020]] Game Update 6.1.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', the seventh digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Site">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190413|text=Announcing 'Onslaught', the Newest Expansion Coming to Star Wars™: The Old Republic™}}</ref>
